import sys

def custom_sort_key(s):
    odd_chars = [s[i] for i in range(len(s)) if i % 2 == 0]
    even_chars = [-ord(s[i]) for i in range(len(s)) if i % 2 == 1]
    return tuple(odd_chars + even_chars)

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
n = int(input[0])
m = int(input[1])
books = input[2:]

sorted_indices = sorted(range(n), key=lambda i: custom_sort_key(books[i]))
print(" ".join(str(i + 1) for i in sorted_indices))
